name: lastwar_capture_reference
description: Phase 0 calibration helper. Focuses Last War (if present) and saves a cropped (or full-desktop fallback) screenshot as a named reference under .slack-agent/lastwar/refs/. Use names like 'claim_button' or 'barracks'. Overwrites a latest-<name>.png convenience pointer. Requires BreakSandbox. Returns paths for later locator use.

name.description: Logical element name for the reference (e.g. 'claim_all', 'train_infantry')
